stops.name: Lovatnet
stops.detail: Lovatnet (also Loenvatnet and Lodalsvatnet) is a lake in the municipality of Stryn in the province of Vestland in Norway.

stops.name: Loen
stops.detail: The lake is located about two kilometers southeast of the village of Loen.

stops.name: Jostedalsbreen
stops.detail: The lake is fed by the glaciers Jostedalsbreen and Tindefjellbreen.
